scope.summary: Mode conversion MUST be an explicit, reversible-where-lossless operation between the models of [STU-COL-002], carrying model-specific options: Bitmap conversion exposes method (50% threshold, pattern dither, diffusion dither, halftone screen with frequency/angle/shape, custom pattern) and output resolution; Indexed conversion exposes palette type, color count, forced colors, transparency, matte, and dither with an editable color table; Duotone conversion exposes mono/duo/tri/quadtone ink slots with per-ink transfer curves + overprint colors; Grayscale conversion exposes the tonal mapping. Lossy conversions warn before discarding channels. Operator dialog + model command.
acceptance_criteria: Explicit mode conversion with Bitmap/Indexed/Duotone/Grayscale option sets
expected_tests: live: Bitmap (method+resolution), Indexed (palette/count/forced/matte/dither/table), Duotone (ink slots+curves+overprint), Grayscale (tonal) conversions apply
test: lossy conversion warns before discarding channels

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-COL-031] Mode conversion MUST be an explicit, reversible-where-lossless operation between the models of [STU-COL-002], carrying model-specific conversion options: Bitmap conversion exposes method (50% threshold, pattern dither, diffusion dither, halftone screen with frequency/angle/shape, custom pattern) and output resolution; Indexed conversion exposes palette type, color count, forced colors, transparency, matte, and dither with an editable color table; Duotone conversion exposes mono/duo/tri/quadtone ink slots with per-ink transfer curves and overprint colors; Grayscale conversion exposes the tonal mapping (provenance: Photoshop mode-conversion option dialogs, deduped). Lossy conversions warn before discarding channels.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
